verdict.rationale: Gemini in Gmail generates AI output from the user's own mailbox data inside the product: thread summaries, one-click suggested replies, and meeting-time proposals based on Calendar availability. Community users confirm hands-on use of the in-product suggestions, though one reported a hallucinated summary date, and the features require opting into Smart Features. Missing for 10: evidence of broader cross-mailbox insights or analytics beyond per-thread summaries, and documented accuracy safeguards given the reported summary hallucination.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Summarize: Synthesize long email threads into concise bullet points.
suggested replies help you reply in one click, in your voice.
Schedule: Propose meeting times based on your availability in Google Calendar.
One user accepts about 50% of Gmail's improvement suggestions.
